"The launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company," said Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick. The publisher has previously said that it doesn't want to reveal the total number of GTA 6 preorders because "the raw numbers could potentially be misleading," given that it's never seen numbers like these before. Latest Videos From PC Gamer Watch full video here: The $3.35 to $3.5 billion net bookings expectation for the GTA 6 launch period is actually slightly below analyst expectations of $3.51 billion, as compiled by LSEG Data & Analytics (via Reuters ). Take-Two's net bookings for its previous financial quarter, Q2 2027, came in below expectations at $1.60 billion, and 18% drop year-over-year. NBA 2K7 was one of the culprits there. Zelnick told Bloomberg that he thinks anticipation for GTA 6 contributed to NBA 2K27's lower than expected performance.
